content.text: {"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot \"accessory\" is for an item no other slot fits.", "\"is_outfit\" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following \"answer_schema\", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": ["\"description\" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Wool-blend coat in a structured A-line cut to the mid-calf, color #3a4e58 (dark slate blue), heavy gabardine fabric with water-resistant finish; oversized chunky knit sweater with a relaxed fit and dropped shoulders, color #d4b996 (warm camel), fine-gauge merino wool blend; straight-leg trousers with a slight taper at the ankle, color #2c2825 (charcoal black), stretch twill fabric for mobility; knee-length winter boots with a block heel and shearling-lined collar, color #3a4e58 (dark slate blue), nubuck leather with a rubber lug sole; gold-toned hoop earrings and a simple chain necklace in 14k gold vermeil. This outfit works because the dark slate coat anchors the look while staying fully waterproof against the -3 °C snow, ensuring you stay dry during your walk through the city center. The warm camel sweater adds a soft contrast that flatters your complexion without compromising the comfort needed for strolling with a friend. Finally, the practical yet polished combination allows you to feel confident and put-together when stepping into any café or casual evening setting."}
